title: Emrys and the House
author: Isandro Sterling
blurb: Juniper Voss, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
